page.overview:
Who is Eldis?

was the Fremen keeper of Paul Atreides’s prison. He was involved in the conspiracy against Muad’Dib. After Paul discovered this, he asked Stilgar to seek him out. Stilgar informed Paul that Eldis was travelling with a party in the desert, visiting somewhere. Paul ordered him to find Eldis regardless.
